notes: 3D MAP houses (owner 2026-09-25: 房屋墙壁和房顶的颜色可以多样化一点，主色调不变，但可以有不同variant): a WALL tint, multiplied into the wall's own texture per house (Map3DHouses.variant_of hashes the house's spot, so a house keeps its variant). a burnt red, a shade deeper
